problem: Ghost tasks keep re-appearing: _sync_runtime_to_tasks recreates closed tasks from stale events; no workflow rule to clean runtime_errors.json on task close
root_cause: _sync_runtime_to_tasks recreated closed tasks from stale events; no workflow rule to clean runtime_errors.json
solution: 1) server.py: skip re-creation if closed/resolved task exists for same key. 2) CLAUDE.md step 3.7: added runtime event cleanup command

problem: E-FILE-003: read_text_file reads entire file before truncating; file tools return E-CP-003 instead of E-FILE-NNN codes
root_cause: E-FILE-003: read_text_file called target.read_text() loading entire file before truncating; file tools raised RuntimeError giving generic E-CP-003
solution: stream-read up to budget chars; file handlers return success:False with E-FILE-NNN codes

problem: ptt.md missing E-PTT-003 watchdog; map.md missing waiting status and closed_keys ghost prevention
root_cause: ptt.md had no E-PTT-003 entry; map.md missing waiting status and ghost task prevention docs
solution: ptt.md: added E-PTT-003 row. map.md: waiting in 3 places, ghost prevention, cleanup rule.

problem: Add split-view to Flow tab: current steps left, ideal doc right
root_cause: Flow tab had no way to view ideal planned state alongside current steps
solution: Added /flow-ideal/<id> endpoint in server.py, split-view CSS, and DOM-based markdown renderer in map.html

problem: Update ideal/system.md — full lifecycle: startup sequence, first-run branch, versioned tutorial, watchdog, shutdown
root_cause: system.md had only 8 steps, missing startup sequence, post-startup branching, versioned tutorial, and MCP/Storage details
solution: Rewrote Processing Pipeline into 4 blocks: startup, post-startup branching, request loop, watchdog+shutdown. Added TUTORIAL_VERSION concept, full error map, storage table.

problem: Detail Block 3 in system.md + config.yaml: add audio pipeline steps, link PTT as sub-flow of System
root_cause: system.md Block 3 had no audio pipeline detail; config.yaml system flow had 7 steps without PTT drill-down link
solution: Updated system.md Block 3 with 11 steps (mic→gRPC→Whisper→LLM→TTS→SLEEPING); config.yaml system flow updated to 11 steps; PTT flow gets parent:system for drill-down

problem: Expand Block 3 in system.md + config.yaml: add audio_ducking, separate grpc_transport/speech_recognition, add memory read/write steps
root_cause: Block 3 had 6 merged steps missing audio_ducking, separate transport/recognition, memory read+write
solution: Expanded to 16 steps across 5 sections: capture, transmission, recognition, LLM, audio response, completion

problem: Update PTT flow: detailed steps with correct modules for drill-down, add architecture diagrams to ideal/ptt.md
root_cause: PTT steps used grpc_service x3 for everything; no architecture diagrams
solution: 7 clear steps with correct modules enabling sub-flow drill-down; added 3 diagrams to ideal/ptt.md: main flow, tool loop, interrupt path

problem: Add tray_controller step to config.yaml; add architecture diagram to ideal/app_startup.md
root_cause: config.yaml missing tray_controller step 8; no architecture diagram
solution: Added tray_controller as final step; added startup sequence diagram with health-check branch

problem: Fix first_run steps: wrong welcome order, missing FIRST_RUN_COMPLETED write, missing mode_management, tutorial_integration should be separate
root_cause: welcome order wrong (after permissions), missing FIRST_RUN_COMPLETED write step and mode_management, tutorial_integration was embedded
solution: Fixed 6 steps with correct order: check→welcome→permissions→write flag→post-welcome→SLEEPING; added flow diagram with skip branch

problem: Tutorial steps missing PTT wait, user practice run, TUTORIAL_VERSION write; need architecture diagram
root_cause: Tutorial had 3 steps missing PTT wait, practice run, TUTORIAL_VERSION write; bool flag instead of version string
solution: 6 steps with PTT timeout, practice run, version write; tutorial.md updated with TUTORIAL_VERSION concept + architecture diagram

problem: Missing speech_playback stop step and grpc_client open step; wrong module name state_manager vs mode_management
root_cause: Missing speech_playback (stop audio) and grpc_client (open stream) steps; state_manager named incorrectly
solution: 5 steps: detect PTT → stop audio → LISTENING → open stream → mic on; added diagram

problem: Missing volume save and restore steps; wrong trigger (PTT instead of MODE_CHANGED→SPEAKING); volume stays at 20% permanently if not restored
root_cause: Missing volume save/restore steps; wrong trigger; volume stayed at 20% permanently
solution: 6 steps: duck on SPEAKING (save+set 20%), restore on PLAYBACK_COMPLETE (restore+fallback 100%); added diagram

problem: Add scenario sub-flows to email flow with LLM-level steps and status indicators
root_cause: Email had 5 generic module steps; no scenario sub-flows from SKILL.md
solution: 12 scenarios from SKILL.md: read/find/send/reply/edge cases with correct tool chains including email_reply_to_last and tag=verification

problem: Tool call errors not visible in map — when email_read_all returns status:error, map shows green instead of red
root_cause: Tool call errors (status:error) were not reported to runtime_errors.json, so Flow steps stayed green even when tools failed
solution: Added error reporting in both sync and async tool result handling paths in orchestrator.py using getLogger(server.tools.<tool_name>) so map module_id matches flow step module

problem: E-SR-002: empty/short transcript passed silently to LLM instead of speaking I did not catch that
root_cause: E-SR-002: empty transcript passed silently to LLM; user heard nothing when Whisper returned empty result
solution: In processing_workflow._on_recognition_failed: when error==empty_result, publish grpc.tts_request I did not catch that before setting recognition_failed; workflow waits for playback.completed to complete chain -> SLEEPING

problem: E-SYS-002/E-MOD-004: no watchdog — stuck non-SLEEPING states require app restart
root_cause: Gap was already closed before this session
solution: Watchdog fully implemented in mode_management_integration._watchdog_guard(): 30s asyncio timer, publishes mode.request SLEEPING on timeout. Marked fixed in ideal docs.

problem: E-AI-002/E-AI-004: Claude API failure and loop limit → silent SLEEPING, no spoken phrase
root_cause: E-AI-002: API exception yielded error event directly; grpc_server returned raw exception string silently. E-AI-004 was already fixed in orchestrator.py
solution: Added text event with Server error phrase BEFORE error event in _run_orchestrator, so text_chunk reaches client TTS before stream terminates

problem: TUTORIAL_COMPLETED bool cannot detect new features — replace with LAST_TUTORIAL_VERSION from VERSION file
root_cause: Gap was wrong — tutorial already uses ledger with per-pack version tracking, not a single bool
solution: System already works: new delta pack in config.yaml → reconcile adds it as pending → selector finds it → shown automatically. Updated ideal docs.

problem: code field missing in tool results — server cannot distinguish error types
root_cause: dispatch wrapper only caught success:False but not status:error; email reply/send missing specific codes
solution: 3 fixes: (1) wrapper now catches status==error too; (2) email_reply_to_last gets E-EMAIL-005; (3) send_email failure gets E-EMAIL-003 via setdefault

problem: E-GRPC-003: reconnect has no retry limit — can loop indefinitely on connection loss
root_cause: Gap was wrong — _ensure_connected_in_grpc_loop already has max_retries=3 with exp backoff since initial implementation
solution: Updated ideal docs to mark E-GRPC-001 and E-GRPC-003 as fixed

problem: E-PERM-002/003: Accessibility/Screen denied can crash instead of degraded mode
root_cause: Gap description was inaccurate. V2 orchestrator with default config (require_all_hard_pass=true) returns should_restart=false when accessibility/screen is denied, falls through to _complete(full_mode=True), publishes system.ready_to_greet correctly.
solution: No code fix needed. App already launches in degraded mode when hard permissions are denied. On-demand NSAlert added separately (v5.0.0.190) to inform user when they trigger a denied-permission feature.

problem: Online monitoring dashboard: cloud_push.py + map.html dual mode + GitHub Pages on nexy-monitor repo
root_cause: Not a code gap — infrastructure already configured
solution: cloud_push.py running, GitHub Pages live at seregawpn.github.io/nexy-monitor/. Dual-mode already in map.html (IS_STATIC flag).

problem: E-GRPC-004: missing audio chunks not detected — partial response played as complete
root_cause: Gap was theoretical — AudioChunk proto has no seq_num field; TCP/gRPC guarantees ordered delivery; missing chunk = stream failure not silent partial
solution: Docs updated to mark as not applicable

problem: Real-time monitoring: replace poll watcher with watchdog + add asyncio exception handler in server/client
root_cause: poll watcher (10s interval)
solution: Replaced FileWatcher with watchdog.Observer in watcher.py. Instant FSEvents notification, 1s debounce, mtime filter against FSEvents replay.

problem: file_search directory scope: LLM sets directory without enforcement, no broaden-on-irrelevant-results fallback (F4f leads CSV on Desktop not found, search scoped to documents)
root_cause: file_search default scope was effectively single-folder: LLM often passed directory="documents" (or other folder) even when the user did not name a folder, and _DIRECTORY_KEYWORDS["documents"]=("document",) matched the generic word "document" in queries like "find my bank statements document", so Guard #1 never stripped it. With no broaden-on-empty retry and file_searcher requiring an exact folder match when directory was set, results were silently confined to one folder.
solution: Guard #1 (before_tool_call) now strips directory from file_search unless the user actually named that folder via _DIRECTORY_KEYWORDS; documents now requires explicit phrases ("documents folder","my documents","in documents","in the documents") so the bare word "document" no longer matches. Guard #2 (on_turn_end) forces one retry without directory if a scoped search returns 0 candidates. file_searcher.search() defaults to {desktop,downloads,documents} when directory is omitted (Messages/Mail still require explicit directory). Verified via 35/35 unit tests in test_hook_continuation_guard.py + new tests in test_file_searcher.py, and F4f/F4g E2E re-runs showing broadened result sets including Desktop. problem: Extract duplicated _strip_html (notes_actions vs email_actions) into shared client/modules/common util
Reports > Phases: add report_date field with date-grouped list + file attachments per report
root_cause: Reports/Phases tab had no date dimension and no way to attach result files to a daily report entry.
solution: Added report_date field (default=today) to phases.json entries with date-grouped/sorted list in map.html. Added base64-JSON attachment endpoints (POST/GET/DELETE /phases/<id>/attachments[/<filename>]) storing files under tools/map/report_attachments/<phase_id>/, with filename sanitization (basename + whitelist regex rejecting . and ..) and 5MB limit. Frontend shows attachment list with image thumbnails, links, delete buttons, and an upload input. DELETE /phases/<id> now also removes its attachments dir. Added 4 passing tests covering report_date defaulting, upload/download/delete, path-traversal/oversize rejection, and cleanup on phase delete. Updated Docs/architecture/tools/map.md and INDEX.md.
